introduce: Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. \n\nThis exercise strengthens the abdomen, back and shoulders.
name: PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your lower back.
Too hard? Lower your knees on the mat with your ankles crossed in the air.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
It's not right if your shoulders or lower back are sore.
This exercise works your core.
This exercise is good for your spine.

introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start in the push-up position, but keep your arms straight. This exercise strengthens your abdomen and back muscles.
name: STRAIGHT-ARM PLANK

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your hands directly underneath your shoulders.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Do not sink your lower back or raise your hips in the air.
Breathe deeply.
Too easy for you? Add weight on your lower back.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise really works on your core and lower back.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your body. Hold your body in a straight line. \n\nThis exercise targets the abdominal muscles and obliques.
name: SIDE PLANK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your arm at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Open your chest.
Always keep your body straight.
Put pressure on your wrist and elbow.
Don't put pressure on your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, put your top foot forward on the mat.
Your abdominals will be burning, maybe even shivering.
Your shoulder should not be sore.
This exercise can strengthen your core.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position.\nLift your right arm and left leg until they are parallel with the ground.\nReturn to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: DIAGONAL PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your head, spine and neck in line.
Tighten your abdominals.
Exhale when raising your arm and leg, and inhale when lowering them.
If it's too hard for you, you can only raise your arm or leg.
This exercise includes almost all the muscles from your shoulders to your heels.
This is a good exercise for your back.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position. Then alternately lift and lower both legs up and down.
name: PLANK LEG UP

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight and your glutes engaged.
Keep your body straight.
Take deep and steady breaths.
To get more of a challenge, simultaneously raise your opposite arm and leg.
This exercise targets your shoulders, abs, quads, glutes and lower back.

introduce:
Start in a traditional plank position, then alternately extend one arm forward.

Keep your body straight during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the abdominal muscle and deltoid muscle.
name: PLANK AND REACH

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Please keep your body straight during the exercise.
Please squeeze your glutes when reaching your arms out.
Please keep your abs tight and engaged.
Please don\'t sink or raise your hips.
It’s a great exercise for your abdominal muscles and deltoid muscles.

introduce:
Start in a left side plank position, then lift your upper leg and kick it forward. Return to the start position and repeat.

Don’t sway your hips and keep your legs and upper body straight during the exercise. 

Exhale when your leg kicks out and inhale when your leg comes back.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus and quadriceps.
name: SIDE PLANK FRONT KICK LEFT

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Please keep your legs and upper body straight.
Make sure your core is engaged.
Please don’t sway your hips.
This exercise works on your glutes, your thighs and your core.

introduce:
Start in a right side plank position, then lift your upper leg and kick it forward. Return to the start position and repeat.

Don’t sway your hips and keep your legs and upper body straight during the exercise. 

Exhale when your leg kicks out and inhale when your leg comes back.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus and quadriceps.
name: SIDE PLANK FRONT KICK RIGHT

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Please keep your legs and upper body straight.
Make sure your core is engaged.
Please don’t sway your hips.
This exercise works on your glutes, your thighs and your core.

introduce:
Start in the straight arm plank position. 

Then bend your right arm and place your forearm on the ground with your elbow under your shoulder, then bend your left arm and come down into the traditional plank position. 

Then reverse and come back to the start position. Repeat the exercise.

Keep your body straight during the exercise. Inhale when you come down and exhale when you come up.

It's a great exercise for the quadriceps, triceps and abdominal muscles.
name: UP AND DOWN PLANK

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs extended straight.
Please keep your head, neck and spine aligned.
Please don\'t sink or raise your hips.
This exercise strengthens and tones your core, arms, glutes, wrists and shoulders.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your upper body and your left hand on the ground in front of you. \n\nKeep both legs together. Lift your legs lightly and hold for one second, then return to the start position. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE LEG RAISE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your legs are straight.
Please do this slowly to avoid hurting your hip.
Please keep your elbow at a 90 degree angle.
Please keep your feet together.
Please hold your legs for one second when lifting them.
Please don\'t rotate your hips when lifting your legs.
Exhale when lifting your legs and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your obliques burning, even shivering.
It\'s a great workout for your obliques.
This exercise can help burn off your love handles.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your upper body and your right hand on the ground in front of you. \n\nKeep both legs together. Lift your legs lightly and hold for one second, then return to the start position. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE LEG RAISE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your legs are straight.
Please do this slowly to avoid hurting your hip.
Please keep your elbow at a 90 degree angle.
Please keep your feet together.
Please hold your legs for one second when lifting them.
Please don\'t rotate your hips when lifting your legs.
Exhale when lifting your legs and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your obliques burning, even shivering.
It\'s a great workout for your obliques.
This exercise can help burn off your love handles.

introduce:
Lie on your right side. Put your right elbow directly under your shoulders and put your left hand on your waist. Place your left leg on your right leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.
name: SIDE BRIDGES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

introduce:
Lie on your left side. Put your left elbow directly under your shoulders and put your right hand on your waist. Place your right leg on your left leg.

Raise your hips upward, hold for 2-4 seconds, then go back to the start position.

Repeat this exercise.
name: SIDE BRIDGES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
You should feel your obliques burning.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your bottom knee on the floor.
It’s a great exercise for your obliques.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring one knee and the opposite elbow in to touch each other, then bring them back. Repeat with the other side.
name: CROSS KNEE PLANK

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please put your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Please keep your body straight.
Please make sure your abs are engaged.
It works on your abs, obliques and hip flexors.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK JACKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.

introduce: Start in the plank position. Shift your body back and forth.
name: BODY SAW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise works your core and your shoulders.

introduce:
Start in a standard plank position. 

Twist your spine to your left side until your left leg touches the floor, then twist to the other side. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK HIP DIPS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please don't sink or raise your hips.
If you feel it's too hard, you can twist without letting your legs touch the floor.
Take deep and steady breaths.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, hips up and fingers pointing forward under your shoulders. \n\nKick your feet in the air alternating left and right.
name: CRAB KICK UP

tips.text: Please don’t let your hips touch the floor and keep your arms straight.
This exercise works all your large muscle groups and especially your gluteus.

introduce: Lay prone on the ground with arms supporting your body. Hop forward, bring your knees toward your chest, then hop back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: IN & OUTS

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Exhale as you hop forward, and inhale as you hop back.
This cardio exercise helps burn body fat and strengthen your core.
